# Quote Template

The `Quote` template formats key statements, pull quotes, and memorable declarations using large, centered serif/display typography.

## Layout Behavior

* Centers content both vertically and horizontally in the slide canvas.
* Automatically styles blockquotes (`> `) with prominent accent borders, enlarged quotation typography, and formatted attribution lines.

## Example Markdown

```markdown
---
template: Quote
---
> "Simplicity is prerequisite for reliability."
>
> — Edsger W. Dijkstra
```

## Structure

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│                                              │
│      “ Simplicity is prerequisite            │
│             for reliability. ”               │
│                                              │
│             — Edsger W. Dijkstra             │
│                                              │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
